vs.err_ffmpeg_missing:
⚠️ ffmpeg could not be found, so the video and audio tracks cannot be merged.
Install ffmpeg from https://ffmpeg.org, put its `bin` folder on PATH and restart TubeCLI — or add `"ffmpeg_path"` to `data/global_settings.json`.
